scripts.// build: Builds every workspace package it imports rather than trusting them to already be there. Their dist/ is gitignored and produced by a `prepare` hook, so it only exists if an install actually ran — and on a CI or Vercel builder with a warm node_modules cache, install is a no-op and dist never appears. Adding an import from a workspace package means adding it here too: the route handlers pulled in @parley/server and this line did not, which broke the cold build.
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @parley/sdk build && pnpm --filter @parley/server build && next build
